note: Devy rankings: KTC devy market blended with the StatHead college-profile model (scripts/train_devy_model.py; score = expected mean of best two NFL PPR PPG seasons in the first four). value = devy scale (KTC 0-9999) in our order; dynasty.value = the same player priced as the rookie-draft slot his class rank implies, from KTC future pick values, comparable to NFL players and picks. modelVsMarket = market position rank minus model position rank (positive: the model likes him more). source: ktc+model, ktc (no college profile matched), model (not on KTC's list; enters at the class market floor). Model features stop at the 2025 season.
